text:
rohit_prod: Internal launch note  were opening a small GH200 Dedicated pool in sa-east-1 (São Paulo) spanning zones a/b. Targeted for latency-sensitive Latin American customers and compliance-bound workloads.

devin_infra: Rollout details: 10 GH200 GPUs per zone (total 20). Soft per-account cap = 3 GPUs/zone. Hard cap per-tenant = 8 GPUs/region for now. To request >soft-cap, open a quota request under "Dedicated GPU - GH200" with expected tokens/sec and peak seq len. Typical review: 48-72h.

carmen_sales: Any special price or migration credits for customers moving from hosted to Dedicated in SA? Also wanting to know pilot capacity for partners.

rohit_prod: No blanket discounts for initial rollout. Pilot slots = 3 for validated partners. Sales can request one-off migration credits through partner-ops for strategic deals. Priority allocation: (1) current Dedicated customers with commitments, (2) enterprise SLO customers active in region, (3) approved pilots.

infra-bot: Pool snapshot (sa-east-1a/b): p95 token-latency = 58ms, p99 = 95ms, avg GPU util = 28%. Health: 18/20 nodes healthy; 2 nodes restarted during staging validation (storage firmware). No customer-side evictions observed.

marta_ops: Incident note: during pre-prod validation we hit a storage firmware bug causing 2 GH200 nodes to reboot. Patch applied, nodes back up. Root cause logged and vendor FW ticket opened. No customer migrations were in-flight; but if anyone sees anomalies, escalate to #eng-oncall.

rohit_prod: Policy update (internal): introducing an "early-commit cancellation" policy for alpha Dedicated pools: if a customer cancels a Dedicated monthly commit within the first 30 days, a 10% early-release fee of the committed monthly amount applies to discourage churn for scarce alpha capacity. This is temporary and applies only to alpha pools (sa-east-1 GH200). @devin_infra, please add `early_cancel_fee` field to the reservation API and surface it in the reservation UI.

devin_infra: Will add API field `early_cancel_fee_pct` (integer) and reservation enum `reserve_tier: ["alpha","standard","enterprise"]`. Also adding an alert that pages if regional spare capacity < 12% and a dashboard tile for GH200 in sa-east-1.

support-bot: Support reminder: for quota requests include expected tokens/sec, peak seq len, preferred zone and whether request is for "alpha" pool. Tag tickets with "dedicated-sa-east-gh200".

carmen_sales: Copy. I'll update AMs and start outreach to top LATAM prospects. Any recommended messaging for customers worried about early-cancel fee?

rohit_prod: Messaging: explain scarcity + pilot nature, emphasize pilot slots and migration assistance. AMs can request exceptions via partner-ops for strategic accounts. Internal doc: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/dedicated/gh200-sa-east1 (includes pricing, quota form, migration checklist, incident log).

marta_ops: Action items: (1) ops to update KB and add incident postmortem note @marta_ops, (2) eng-infra to add API field and capacity alert @devin_infra, (3) sales to log pilot interest and handle exceptions @carmen_sales.

devin_infra: Noted. Adding the API changes and alert; will notify once deployed.

rohit_prod: We'll wait 72h of stable telemetry before any external-facing comms. Thanks team :latin_america:
